tickets.outcome: Size S of the Classic Bulldog Tee was out of stock (0 on hand; M 5, L 3, XL 2 available). The only restock path, Bulldog Print Co, was blocked by overdue invoice 501 ($840.00, 3 days overdue). Accounting prepared payment request #1 for the invoice; a human approved it, which unblocked the vendor (earliest ETA 2026-09-05). Customer Service drafted draft #1 to Tauhid offering M/L/XL now or waiting for S, with the date stated as conditional. A human then closed the ticket.

agents.contribution: Read the ticket, the order overview and the cash position; briefed Inventory and Accounting together, then Customer Service once their facts were in; decided awaiting_human_approval.
Confirmed S = 0 and the shortfall of 1, named Bulldog Print Co by its apparel-reprint specialty, its 5-day lead time, the invoice 501 block and the 2026-09-05 ETA.
Checked cash ($3,400.00, rent $2,400.00 due in 2 days) and prepared payment request #1 for invoice 501 ($840.00), leaving $160.00 after rent.
Consulted by Inventory about the blocking invoice; found request #1 already pending and did not create a duplicate.
Saved draft #1 to Tauhid Zaman (not sent): S unavailable, restock being arranged, earliest arrival September 5 if approval is completed today, offer of another size.

tickets.outcome: 20 hoodies in M were requested but only 8 are on hand (12 short). A 20% bulk discount ($46.40 each, 52.6% margin, $488.00 profit) was judged profitable, but restocking the 12 would cost $264.00 against only $160.00 of cash, so no purchase order was prepared and the restock was deferred until a customer deposit or more cash covers at least the $104.00 gap. Customer Service saved draft #2 with the discount and a partial-order option. A human closed the ticket as resolved: the quote stands pending a customer deposit, the restock waits for funding, and draft #2 must be rewritten without its unfunded September 5 date before it is sent.

agents.contribution: Read the ticket, quoted the order at 10% and checked cash; briefed Inventory, Accounting and Customer Service in one turn; re-quoted at 20%; decided deferred with next steps (deposit or $104.00 more cash before the PO).
Confirmed M = 8 (12 short), other sizes S 4 / L 14 / XL 6, Bulldog Print Co unblocked with a 5-day lead time (ETA 2026-09-05), restock cost $264.00.
At 10% off: $30.20 profit per hoodie, 57.9% margin, $604.00 total; the $264.00 restock exceeds the $160.00 cash, so it did NOT prepare a purchase order.
Consulted by Customer Service for the discount to offer; compared 0%, 20% and 25% and recommended 20% ($46.40 each, 52.6% margin).

Asked Accounting for the discount, then saved draft #2 to Yale AI Club (not sent): 20% off at $46.40, 8 available now, 12 to restock, partial-order option. Flaw: it states the restock is expected by September 5 although no restock is funded.
